column1: # L2 Rule A pilots: precision learning of the theta weight (2026-10-28; docs/learning_design.md §4, §8).
# Base: r1k-stale-y50 (arms/rung1_cap.tsv: the capped fire-sale reference bank with a
# stale public signal y0 = 0.5), 20 episodes, one mixed cell (mu 0.5, lambda 0.1 / 0.9),
# common seeding: every arm sees the same populations and episode draws, so the
# learning arms pair with lrn-y50-none run for run and episode for episode.
#   lrn-y50-none      no learning (the control; also an L1 null check with y on)
#   lrn-y50-k50-ins   kappa 0.5 under deposit insurance at the 0.99 quantile (Q2)
# Not run: the design note's "nopub" arm (Rule A scores y against theta, so it needs
# a public signal) and "wealth" (EPISODE_RESET=wealth is not built).
# What to read (exploratory; no pre-registration, the user 10-28): by episode, the
# theta weight of I and C (with y0 stale, MSE_y ~ E[(0.5 - theta)^2] = 1/12 against
# MSE_x ~ 0.01, so the experienced weight is ~0.11 and C's 0.9 should fall toward it),
# P(fail), and the I - C withdrawal gap, each against lrn-y50-none.
# tag
